newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's foreign reserves hit six-month high.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's foreign reserves hit six-month high.

text.p: Colombia's net foreign reserves reached a six-month high of $8.06 billion as Aug. 9, according to the latest figures made available by the country's central bank.
Reserves have been edging up steadily since July 13 on rising oil export revenues, the disbursement of foreign credits to the public sector and increasing foreign invesment flows.
A total of $572.9 million in net foreign investment entered Colombia between Jan. 1 and Aug. 9, an increase of 186.1 percent over the same period last year, the central bank figures show.
